subject: CS231
filterSummary: Filtered out 422 videos that were either irrelevant (e.g., general adder/subtractor theory, half adder, BCD addition without circuit design), wrong language (Hindi, Tamil, Urdu, etc.), too short (<60s), too long (>3600s), or low quality/duplicate channels per topic. Selected the top 5 English and 5 Arabic videos with high relevance and quality, covering each of the five hardest topics.
